in_sanskrit.name: Arsika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Arising from the cosmos
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arsika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Arsika is a Sanskrit name derived from the root words 'ars' meaning 'arise' and 'ik' meaning 'cosmos'. This name signifies the one who arises from the cosmos or the universe itself. It is a name that carries deep spiritual significance and is often given to a child believed to be a divine gift.
